proposal.reason: Main change is CI/test-workflow orchestration: dual-platform (M890P+810E) case generation/grouping/execution, scheduler allocation/device mapping, HPN SDK install wiring, daily/source-sanity workflow updates, reconciliation/reporting/artifact behavior, and extensive xtest workflow-contract coverage. Build/script and docs edits are in support of this CI execution path rather than separate build-system or runtime module behavior.
